description:
[Feedback] Send a feature request to the JobMojito product team. It is posted on the public feature request board under the signed-in user's name, where they get status updates; the company is not named. Write a short title and a description of the need and why (no candidate data or company names). Confirm the wording with the user before submitting; at most 5 a day.

Sends a feature request to the JobMojito product team. It is posted on the public feature request board under your name (from your account e-mail), where you get status updates and others can vote on it; your company is not named. At most 5 requests per user in 24 hours. Requires a user token (admin console session or MCP sign-in) of a merchant, merchant owner or admin.

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

description.description: What the user needs and why: the problem, how they work around it today, who it would help. Plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs. The board is public: do not include candidate data, company names or other personal information.
description.example: We review applications in a spreadsheet every Friday. Today we export each interview separately; one CSV per position would save an hour a week.

title.description: A short summary of the feature, shown as the post title.
title.example: Export all results of a position as one CSV

name: submit_feature_request

status.description: `posted`: it is on the feature request board. `queued`: stored, it is posted shortly (the board could not be reached right now).

title: Submit feature request
